description: Returns the domains served by one server's web server configuration and the number of days until each SSL certificate expires.
name: get_domains

days_until_expiry.description: Days until the SSL certificate expires; null when unknown.

domain.description: Domain served by the web server.

ssl_error.description: Present when the certificate could not be checked.

error.description: Present only when the call failed: why, in plain English (unknown server, server from another workspace, not a Kubernetes cluster).

title: Domains and SSL expiry
